```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(plotly)

district_summary <- tibble(
Category = c(
"Mean Democratic Vote Share",
"Median Democratic Vote Share",
"Mean-Median Score",
"Efficiency Gap",
"Total D Wasted Votes",
"Total R Wasted Votes",
"Democratic Seats Won",
"Republican Seats Won"
),
Before = c(
61.58, 63.08, -1.5, -9.13, 3064992, 4433524, 43, 9
),
After = c(
61.58, 63.08, -4.3, -28.64, 2904403, 5236623, 50, 2
)
)

```

```{r}
datatable(
district_summary,
options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = 't'),
caption = "Comparison of Redistricting Statistics: Before vs After Gerrymander"
)
```

```{r}
seat_data <- tibble(
Party = rep(c("Democrats", "Republicans"), 2),
Seats = c(43, 9, 50, 2),
Scenario = rep(c("Before Gerrymander", "After Gerrymander"), each = 2)
)

plot_ly(seat_data, x = ~Scenario, y = ~Seats, color = ~Party, type = 'bar') %>%
layout(barmode = 'group',
title = "Seats Won by Party",
yaxis = list(title = "Number of Seats"))

```

```{r}
wasted_data <- tibble(
Party = rep(c("Democrats","Republicans"),2),
WastedVotes = c(3064992, 4433524, 2904403, 5236623),
Scenario = rep(c("Before Gerrymander","After Gerrymander"), each=2)
)

plot_ly(wasted_data, x = ~Scenario, y = ~WastedVotes, color = ~Party, type='bar') %>%
layout(barmode = 'group',
title = "Wasted Votes by Party",
yaxis = list(title = "Number of Wasted Votes"))
```

```{r}
vote_data <- tibble(
Metric = rep(c("Mean","Median"),2),
VoteShare = c(61.58, 63.08, 61.58, 63.08),
Scenario = rep(c("Before Gerrymander","After Gerrymander"), each=2)
)

plot_ly(vote_data, x=~Scenario, y=~VoteShare, color=~Metric, type='scatter', mode='lines+markers') %>%
layout(title="Mean and Median Democratic Vote Share",
yaxis=list(title="Vote Share (%)"))

```
